description: This file defines Greek (Greece) localization settings for the DateJS library, including culture info such as date formats, month and day names, and various date parsing and formatting functions tailored for the Greek language and locale.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time portion of the Date object to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date's time to the current system time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this date to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name in various formats.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name in various formats.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Checks if a year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month of a year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a given timezone name.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets multiple parts of a date object based on a configuration object.

methods.name: moveToFirstDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to the first day of its month.

methods.name: moveToLastDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to the last day of its month.

methods.name: moveToNthOccurrence
methods.description: Moves the date to the nth occurrence of a weekday in the month.

methods.name: moveToDayOfWeek
methods.description: Moves the date to a specific day of the week.

methods.name: moveToMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to a specific month.

methods.name: getWeek
methods.description: Calculates the week number within the year for the date.

methods.name: getISOWeek
methods.description: Calculates the ISO week number.

methods.name: setWeek
methods.description: Sets the date's week number.

methods.name: toISOString
methods.description: Returns the date in ISO string format.

methods.name: getElapsed
methods.description: Returns the elapsed milliseconds from the date to another date.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the date into a string based on given pattern.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins parsing a date string according to the configured formats.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a date string into a Date object.

methods.name: parseExact
methods.description: Parses a date string according to a specific format.
